tools.title: Clef reader
tools.spec: Show a random note on a random clef from the clef table; the learner names it. Toggle clefs on/off. Middle C marker.

tools.title: Tuning lab
tools.spec: Play a C major triad and a scale in just, Pythagorean, quarter-comma meantone, a well temperament (e.g. Werckmeister III) and equal temperament; show each note's deviation in cents from equal temperament. Use a sine or harpsichord tone with detune.

tools.title: Half/whole step keyboard
tools.spec: Piano keyboard; click two keys to see half/whole step, diatonic vs chromatic spelling (same vs different letter).

tools.title: Scale builder
tools.spec: Pick tonic + scale (major, natural/harmonic/melodic minor, chromatic, major/minor pentatonic, 7 modes). Draw on staff with W/H/1½ labels under each step, scale-degree numbers and solfège (fixed/movable toggle). Melodic minor plays up and down.

tools.title: Mode wheel
tools.spec: Rotate a major scale to each mode; highlight the characteristic note vs Ionian/Aeolian; order modes bright→dark (Lydian…Locrian) as in the notes p.6 chart.

tools.title: Circle of fifths
tools.spec: Interactive circle with majors outside, relative minors inside, signatures. Click a key: show its signature on a staff; highlight closely related keys (±1 accidental) for the modulation chapter.

tools.title: Interval lab
tools.spec: Two notes on a staff: name the interval (size + quality), show half steps, inversion (sum 9) and compound/simple form; quiz mode both directions (identify / construct). Play harmonic and melodic.

tools.title: Overtone series
tools.spec: Fundamental selectable; show partials 1–16 on a staff with ratio and approximate interval; play cumulatively; highlight 4:5:6 major triad.

tools.title: Consonance ladder
tools.spec: Stability ranking as a ladder; play each interval; demo the P4 in two contexts (above the bass → resolves to 3; between upper voices over a 5th → stable).

tools.title: Meter & rhythm lab
tools.spec: Choose a time signature; show beat/division/multiple levels as a grid with strong/weak accents; metronome; toggle triplet/duplet, syncopation types and a hemiola demo (two 3/4 bars felt as 3/2).

tools.title: Chord builder
tools.spec: Pick root, quality (4 triads, 7 sevenths) and inversion; show staff, lead-sheet symbol, figured-bass figures, Roman numeral in a chosen key.

tools.title: Diatonic chord table
tools.spec: Grid of diatonic triads/sevenths for major and the three minor forms (data: diatonic-chords tables); rare chords dimmed; click to hear. Mode-mixture view overlays borrowed chords.

tools.title: Harmonic progression chart
tools.spec: Clickable flow chart (major/minor) from notes p.14. Build a progression by clicking; arrows that go backward turn red. Later chapters insert secondary chords before their targets.

tools.title: Melody harmonizer (5 steps)
tools.spec: Enter a short soprano; step through the 5-step procedure: list candidate chords under each note, pick a path through the chart, then hand off to the SATB checker.

tools.title: Figured bass explainer
tools.spec: Bass + figures in, chord spelled out; explain accidental-alone (3rd) and slashed figures; show abbreviations.

tools.title: SATB part-writing checker
tools.spec: Four-voice editor (click on grand staff or type notation). Runs the same checks as tools/satb.py (port to TS) and colours each problem by the notes p.20 checklist level (white→red). Load any example from the data as a starting point.

tools.title: Voicing & spacing explorer
tools.spec: Drag S/A/T/B of one chord; live display of ranges, spacing limits, open/closed/keyboard position, doubling counts.

tools.title: Motion classifier
tools.spec: Two voices, two chords: animate parallel/similar/oblique/contrary; flag parallel, contrary and hidden 5ths/8ves and unequal 5ths with the hidden-interval "fill-in" view.

tools.title: Error gallery
tools.spec: Cards for each checker type, using the intent:"error" examples; play, show the fault highlighted, then the corrected version when one exists.

tools.title: Cadence player & quiz
tools.spec: Play each cadence example; conclusiveness slider (HC/IAC weak → PAC strong); quiz: identify PAC/IAC/HC/PHC/DC/PC/evaded.

tools.title: Period & form diagrams
tools.spec: Render the period and form tables as timelines (phrase boxes, cadence labels, key plan). Optional audio from the cadence examples.

tools.title: Non-chord-tone identifier
tools.spec: Click a highlighted note; answer preparation (step/leap/common tone) and resolution; tool names the NCT using the notes p.27 table logic.

tools.title: V7 → I resolution lab
tools.spec: Toggle complete/incomplete V7 and I; show which combinations work (one chord incomplete) and which create parallel/hidden fifths/octaves; inversions table with bass motions.

tools.title: Seventh-chord inversion tables
tools.spec: Render the V7, viiø7, vii°7 and ii7 tables; each row plays its example progression and highlights the 7th (green) and leading tone (red) as the notes colour them.

tools.title: Secondary function calculator
tools.spec: Choose key + target chord: spell V, V7, vii°, vii°7, viiø7 of it with the 3-step procedures; reverse mode analyses a chromatic chord with the 4-step / 3-step analysis procedures.

tools.title: Circle-of-fifths substitution matrix
tools.spec: C: iii7–vi7–ii7–V7–I with a 3 × 3 matrix (diatonic / secondary dominant / secondary LT) per slot = 27 progressions; play any path.

tools.title: Pivot-chord finder
tools.spec: Pick two keys: list the diatonic triads of each (minor uses harmonic minor as in the notes), highlight common chords with both Roman numerals.

tools.title: Mode-mixture palette
tools.spec: Major key chords plus borrowed chords from the parallel minor; mark which borrowed degree (♭3, ♭6, ♭7) each uses and how common it is.

tools.title: Neapolitan & augmented-sixth builder
tools.spec: Step-by-step spelling (notes p.48 five steps) for It/Fr/Ger; play the resolution to V or I6/4 with the A6 → P8 expansion animated; N6 with ♭2̂ → 7̂ (d3).

tools.title: Tendency-tone map
tools.spec: Keyboard/staff overlay: arrows for 7̂→1̂, ♭6̂→5̂, chordal 7th ↓, tritone resolution; toggle per chord.

checks.label: Voice out of range
Melodic leap larger than M6 in S, A or T (octave allowed)
Doubling: root of 5/3 (except vi/VI after V), bass of 6/4; chordal 7th doubled
Consecutive P5/P8 by contrary motion
Hidden (direct) P5/P8 in the outer voices with a soprano leap (level assigned by the builder; not on the checklist)
Augmented melodic interval
Overlapping voices
Voice crossing
vii° in root position (use vii°6)
6/4 bass approached or left by leap (cadential 6/4 may be approached by leap)
Doubled leading tone
Spacing: S–A or A–T wider than P8, T–B wider than P12
Chordal 7th not resolved down by step
Chordal 7th approached by descending leap (notes p.29; level assigned by the builder)
Leading tone in soprano or bass not resolved up to the tonic (a chromatic half step down, e.g. B → B♭ to become the 7th of V7/IV, is accepted — notes p.38)
Unequal fifths d5 → P5 against the bass (level assigned by the builder)
Augmented 6th does not expand to an octave (♭6̂ down, ♯4̂ up) — notes p.49; level assigned by the builder
Parallel P1/P5/P8
Melodic leap larger than an octave
Notation error: tie between different pitches
